title: Charleston Dolphin Adventure (Private or Public) to 14 guests
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Total duration includes the travel time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our captains are truly a local connection for you to Charleston's Wild Side!!! They will show you all the Lowcountry has to offer while making sure you have a damn good time doing it. 

Captain Ducworth has lived in Charleston since 1995. He spent 18 years as a Spanish Teacher at a local highscool before becoming a full-time fishing and tour guide. He loves interacting with guests, is funny and great with kids and grandparents alike!

Captain Nick is a wizard regarding local wildlife! He's a Charleton native with over a decade of experience as a tour guide. Nick has a masters degree in Environmental and Sustainability Studies. Nick's upbeat positive energy is contagious.

Our departure location is very convenient with plenty of parking and clean amenities! 

Our boats are roomy and comfortable! 

We see dolphins on 99.9% of our tours!

Tide allowing, not too high, we will stop on an uninhabited island to hunt for shells and sharks teeth beneath the Morris Island Lighthouse.
